current_by_section.1: Lives with Oko in the Ibuki area.
current_by_section.2: Goes into the mountains with Takezō to look for mushrooms.
current_by_section.9: In Kyoto she lives with Oko and Matahachi in the Yomogi household.
current_by_section.13: Meets Jōtarō by the Takase and receives the message meant for Matahachi.
current_by_section.23: At Sumiyoshi she searches symbolically for a seashell of forgetfulness and is assaulted by Seijūrō, from whom she manages to escape.
current_by_section.24: Walks into the sea intending to die; Gonroku saves her but drowns. Fishermen revive her and Seijūrō tends her through the fever.
current_by_section.30: Flees the inn, is attacked by Yasoma and rescued first by Tanzaemon, then by Kojirō, who carries her away after treating a wound.
current_by_section.32: Meets Musashi at Gojō Bridge, tells him about the assault and leaves again with Kojirō toward the Zuzuya Inn.
current_by_section.33: Freed by a neighbour after Kojirō tied her up at the inn, she runs to the Yoshioka field looking for Musashi and witnesses the aftermath of Seijūrō's duel.
current_by_section.35: Meets Matahachi while fleeing Kojirō and then manages to get away from both.
current_by_section.37: Arrives at the same inn where Osugi is holding Otsū.
current_by_section.45: Takes Osugi's travel money, leaves a note and flees the inn.
current_by_section.48: Agrees for the time being to travel east with Matahachi.
current_by_section.51: By the time Musashi finds Matahachi, Akemi has already left the inn with the money and luggage.
current_by_section.83: Lives with Matahachi in the Nishikubo house, where Kojirō watches her unseen.
current_by_section.86: Leaves Matahachi and works for Daizō.
current_by_section.93: Arrested without knowing about the plot, she is lashed and banished from Edo together with Matahachi; she survives.
current_by_section.106: In Osaka she is selling shellfish by the river with a baby on her back; Matahachi recognizes her and decides to follow her and act as father, although biological paternity is not established.
current_by_section.109: Enters Kokura with Matahachi and the baby as a poor but functioning family.
current_by_section.110: After hearing Musashi's letter she climbs a hill with Matahachi and the baby to watch Funashima from afar.

current_by_section.4: Takes part in the search and in the trap set to capture Takezō.
current_by_section.6: Whips the captured Takezō, demands he be left hanging in the cryptomeria for ten or twenty days so she can strike the fatal blow herself, and orders Otsū to move into the Hon'iden house once he is dead.
current_by_section.7: Pursues Otsū after leaving the Mikazuki Teahouse.
current_by_section.8: According to Takuan, she left Miyamoto with Gonroku three years earlier and has been hunting Musashi and Otsū for revenge ever since.
current_by_section.11: Reaches Kyoto with Gonroku and confronts Musashi near Hongandō; Musashi refuses to fight.
current_by_section.21: Finds Matahachi again in Osaka and believes his story that he has become Sasaki Kojirō, drawing him into her revenge against Musashi and Otsū.
current_by_section.24: Visits Sumiyoshi with Matahachi and Gonroku; after a quarrel Matahachi walks off.
current_by_section.31: Attacks Musashi by the Kamo with her sword and spits at him, leaving one eye burning; he disarms her and ties her to a boat to await Matahachi.
current_by_section.32: Freed by Musashi, she persuades Otsū to look for Matahachi with her.
current_by_section.37: Holds Otsū by coercion and, threatening to kill herself, forces Matahachi to promise to kill her; she tries to cut the head off the body she thinks is Otsū's, but it is Yasoma's, and she flees when Takuan intervenes.
current_by_section.45: At night she gets ready to leave for Ichijōji with Matahachi and finds that Akemi has made off with her travel money.
current_by_section.48: Matahachi leaves her alone near Mount Daimonji to go off with Akemi.
current_by_section.50: Attacks Musashi at Mudōji; injured and feverish, she is nursed by him despite her hostility.
current_by_section.51: During the journey toward Ōmi she abandons Musashi and escapes toward Sakamoto or Ōtsu.
current_by_section.63: After two months of travel she reaches Edo injured and is taken in at Yajibei's house.
current_by_section.64: The story resumes about a year and a half later: she still lives with Yajibei and meets Kojirō.
current_by_section.75: Learning that Musashi has been located, she heads for Kakubei's house to find Kojirō.
current_by_section.76: Plans an ambush of Musashi with Kojirō; Shinzō pushes her into a ditch during the fight.
current_by_section.79: The Hangawara men spread her demand for revenge against Musashi through Edo.
current_by_section.87: Kidnapped by the Ono students as bait for Kojirō, she is released after the confrontation with Tadaaki.
current_by_section.92: At the Hōjō house she denounces Musashi and provokes Iori's impulsive reaction.
current_by_section.94: Travels with the Hosokawa party and Kojirō when they meet Iori at Nobidome.
current_by_section.104: Takes part in the trap set for Otsū at Mikazuki; Jōtarō intervenes and shuts her in the cave.
current_by_section.105: Freed by Otsū, she attacks her but immediately repents and calls for help to save her.
current_by_section.107: After nursing the sick Otsū she is reconciled with her and continues the journey at her side.
current_by_section.111: Meets Musashi again by the Heike Pine, receives his forgiveness and bows from the shore as he leaves.

current_by_section.3: Welcomes Otsū and Takuan at the house by the river.
current_by_section.4: Is arrested during the search for Takezō.
current_by_section.7: It becomes known that she has been moved toward Himeji.
current_by_section.8: Takuan reports that she is in the Sayo district.

current_by_section.2: Dies in the fight with Takezō.

kohei.role: Bandit and master of the chain-and-sickle

current_by_section.2: Named as a threat and as Temma's brother; his physical presence is not established.
current_by_section.28: The narration explicitly reveals that Shishido Baiken is Tsujikaze Kōhei. He attempts a night ambush on Musashi, who spares him.
current_by_section.90: Leads the ambush on Musashi on the inner path at Mitsumine and dies in the fight.

current_by_section.7: Takes part in the pursuit of Otsū.
current_by_section.11: Is with Osugi when she confronts Musashi near Hongandō.
current_by_section.21: Finds Matahachi again in Osaka together with Osugi.
current_by_section.24: Saves Akemi from drowning at Sumiyoshi but dies in the rescue.

current_by_section.3: His past and his house are part of the background to the events at Miyamoto.

current_by_section.9: Nominally leads the Yoshioka school and spends the evening in the pleasure district with his men.
current_by_section.10: After Musashi's raid he returns to the school; the senior disciples decide to ambush Musashi despite his protests.
current_by_section.23: At Sumiyoshi he isolates and sexually assaults Akemi, who manages to escape.
current_by_section.24: Tends Akemi through her fever, then leaves for Kyoto after receiving Musashi's challenge.
current_by_section.25: Recognizes Ganryū and stops the fight between Kojirō and Ryōhei; the groups continue together toward Kyoto.
current_by_section.31: The school sets the duel with Musashi at Rendaiji for the ninth day of the first month.
current_by_section.33: Musashi shatters his right shoulder; at his request Kojirō amputates the arm, which can no longer be saved.
current_by_section.36: Hands over the house and school to Denshichirō, urges him not to challenge Musashi and then disappears, leaving a long letter.

gion_toji.role: Man attached to the Yoshioka school

current_by_section.9: Accompanies Seijūrō and negotiates with Oko at Yomogi.
current_by_section.10: Recognizes Matahachi after the Yoshioka pursuers mistake him for Musashi.
current_by_section.22: During the voyage he confronts a young swordsman not yet identified, who cuts off his topknot.
current_by_section.23: Rejoins the Yoshioka group at Sumiyoshi, where the loss of his topknot becomes obvious.
current_by_section.60: Leads a group that sets a trap for Musashi; he is wounded and recognized during the fight.
current_by_section.90: Is among the attackers struck by Gonnosuke; his death is still a strong inference at the end of the section.
current_by_section.91: Oko explicitly identifies her husband as the man killed by Gonnosuke, retrospectively confirming Tōji's death.
current_by_section.31: It emerges that a few days earlier he ran off with Okō, taking all the money he had collected for the school on his trip west.

ueda_ryohei.role: Senior member of the Yoshioka school

current_by_section.9: Steps in to stop the brawling among the Yoshioka students.
current_by_section.10: Takes part in the deliberation after Musashi's attack on the school.
current_by_section.24: Delivers Musashi's challenge to Seijūrō at Sumiyoshi.
current_by_section.25: Attacks Kojirō and is defeated; Seijūrō stops the confrontation.
current_by_section.31: Takes part in the Yoshioka preparations for the Rendaiji duel.
current_by_section.33: Is with the Yoshioka men when Seijūrō is brought back from the field gravely wounded.
current_by_section.36: Witnesses the leadership of the school passing from Seijūrō to Denshichirō.

jotaro.role: Young traveler who attaches himself to Musashi

current_by_section.12: Meets Musashi at an inn and decides to follow him toward Nara.
current_by_section.13: Delivers Musashi's messages in Kyoto, then travels part of the way toward Nara with Otsū and Kizaemon, whom he meets by chance, and parts from them at the Kizu ferry.
current_by_section.15: Watches the fight on Hannya Plain from a hill.
current_by_section.16: Arrives in Yagyū Valley with Musashi and meets Kocha.
current_by_section.19: Continues the journey after leaving Sekishūsai's mountain house.
current_by_section.27: With Otsū he finds Musashi's belongings at Ise and leaves again for Kyoto with the scrolls entrusted by Ujitomi.
current_by_section.29: Escapes the runaway horse, goes back to look for Otsū and frees her with Sannojō's help.
current_by_section.32: Watches Musashi meet Akemi and decides to return to the Karasumaru house while Otsū follows Osugi.
current_by_section.33: Searches for Otsū among the Yoshioka men waiting on the field.
current_by_section.42: Looks after the feverish Otsū at the Karasumaru residence and sets out angrily for the Ōgiya after Takuan's words.
current_by_section.43: At the Ōgiya he injures a servant with his wooden sword, then joins Musashi in Yoshino's cottage and gets ready to leave the quarter with him.
current_by_section.44: Parts from Musashi at the Yanagi Riding Grounds and brings Otsū his message.
current_by_section.47: Accompanies the sick Otsū on the mountain road and meets Musashi before the Ichijōji fight.
current_by_section.52: Rejoins Musashi and Otsū at Seta Bridge and takes part in the journey east.
current_by_section.53: Understands that the journey has entered a serious pause and waits with Otsū by the waterfalls.
current_by_section.91: Under the shortened name Jōta he accompanies Daizō in moving the treasure; he confesses the plot and is sent to find his father Tanzaemon.
current_by_section.104: Finds Otsū again, defeats her captors and shuts Osugi in the Mikazuki cave.
current_by_section.107: Accompanies Otsū and Osugi to the Shikama estuary to meet Musashi's ship and reports that he refused to come ashore.
current_by_section.111: Witnesses the farewells by the Heike Pine but cannot speak directly with Musashi before he leaves.

shoda_kizaemon.role: Senior retainer of the Yagyū house

current_by_section.13: Travels with Otsū, returns Jōtarō's lost bamboo tube and continues toward Koyagyū.
current_by_section.17: Reports to Sekishūsai on the outcome of his errand to the Kyoto guests.
current_by_section.18: Hosts Musashi at the Shin'indō and, after the dog is killed, confronts him with Kimura, Debuchi and Murata.
current_by_section.74: An urgent letter from him tells the Yagyū house in Edo that Sekishūsai is gravely ill.

current_by_section.14: Meets Musashi in the temple garden near the Hōzōin and teaches him after the duel with Agon.
current_by_section.15: Reaches Hannya Plain with officials and explains to Musashi the meaning of the ordeal.

current_by_section.14: Faces Musashi in the dōjō and dies in the fight.

yamazoe_dampachi.role: Rōnin and promoter of public matches

current_by_section.14: Approaches Musashi near Sarusawa together with Banryū and Yasubei; Musashi refuses.
current_by_section.15: Confronts Musashi on Hannya Plain and is killed.

current_by_section.14: Takes part in the attempt to recruit Musashi.
current_by_section.15: Is among the rōnin involved in the fight on Hannya Plain and dies in the battle.
Appears in person in the final phase of the fight on Hannya Plain and leads the lancers' charge.

kocha.role: Young helper at the Wataya inn

current_by_section.16: Meets Jōtarō at the inn and quarrels playfully with him.
current_by_section.17: Welcomes Otsū at the Wataya and directs her to Denshichirō.
current_by_section.18: Tends Jōtarō's wounds at the Wataya and says goodbye when he leaves with Musashi for the castle.

yoshioka_denshichiro.role: Seijūrō's younger brother and Yoshioka representative

current_by_section.16: Is recognized among the guests from Kyoto in Yagyū Valley.
current_by_section.17: Receives at the Wataya the letter and peony sent by Sekishūsai through Otsū.
current_by_section.36: Returns to Kyoto, accepts the leadership of the Yoshioka house and, against Seijūrō's advice, resolves to challenge Musashi by a letter setting time and place.
current_by_section.39: Faces Musashi at Rengeōin and is killed in the duel.

sekishusai.role: Elderly master of the Yagyū house

current_by_section.17: Lives in the mountain house with Otsū, arranges a peony and declines to meet Denshichirō through a written reply.
current_by_section.19: Musashi reaches his house, but the text does not establish a face-to-face meeting between them.

current_by_section.17: Is present in the Yagyū circle during the peony errand.
current_by_section.18: With the other seniors he hosts Musashi at the Shin'indō; after the dog is killed he accepts Musashi's challenge and faces him with the sword.
current_by_section.71: Recognizes Musashi at the horse market and invites him to the Yagyū house; Musashi sends Iori with a letter.
current_by_section.73: It is reported that he earlier rescued Otsū from Matahachi and brought her under Yagyū protection.
current_by_section.77: His reply postpones the bout Musashi asked for.

current_by_section.20: Works at the Fushimi construction site and takes the money, bundle and certificate of a dead traveler; the certificate does not identify the dead man as Kojirō.
current_by_section.21: In Osaka he falsely presents himself as Sasaki Kojirō and is swindled by Yasoma; then he is reunited with Osugi and Gonroku.
current_by_section.24: Quarrels with Osugi during the visit to Sumiyoshi and walks off.
current_by_section.35: His false identity is publicly exposed by the real Kojirō; he loses the certificate and pillbox and gives his own name, Hon'iden Matahachi.
current_by_section.37: Tries to force Otsū to come back to him and strikes Yasoma in the dark believing it is her; then he flees with Osugi.
current_by_section.45: Leaves with Osugi for Ichijōji after learning of the imminent duel.
current_by_section.48: Leaves Osugi on the mountain and persuades Akemi to travel east with him.
current_by_section.51: Meets Musashi for the first time since Sekigahara; he accepts the invitation to start over and is sent to find Osugi.
current_by_section.52: Kojirō mocks him by calling him Inugami, a name Matahachi rejects; drunk, he misses the Seta meeting and goes back to resenting Musashi.
current_by_section.83: Lives with Akemi at Nishikubo and tells Kojirō about his misadventures.
current_by_section.86: After Akemi leaves, he takes Daizō's money to enter the castle as a well digger and assassinate Hidetada.
current_by_section.93: Gives up the plan, is caught, has his head shaved by Takuan, is lashed and banished from Edo; he survives.
current_by_section.102: At the Hachijōji, where he has been waiting for Gudō since meeting Musashi again in Kamakura, he repents and makes clear that his earlier coercion of Otsū did not end in sexual contact; then he walks west with Gudō.
current_by_section.103: Continues with Gudō toward Kyoto after Musashi stops following them.
current_by_section.106: In Osaka he abandons his unfinished monastic path and chooses to work with Akemi and be a father to the baby.
current_by_section.109: Lives with Akemi and the baby in Kokura as a chosen family.
current_by_section.110: Climbs a Kokura hill with them to watch Funashima and pray from afar.

current_by_section.27: Loses her place at the House of Virgins and receives from Ujitomi some scrolls to deliver to Karasumaru Mitsuhiro in Kyoto.
current_by_section.29: Is captured by Baiken's men and freed by Jōtarō with Sannojō's help; she then reaches Kyoto.
current_by_section.32: Watches Musashi and Akemi's meeting from hiding, chases Musashi and finally agrees to look for Matahachi with Osugi.
current_by_section.37: Resists Osugi's coercion, rejects Matahachi and declares her love for Musashi; Takuan finds her unconscious but alive.
current_by_section.42: Lies feverish at the Karasumaru residence while Jōtarō looks after her.
current_by_section.44: Goes out to the rear gate after Musashi's departure and finds Jōtarō in tears.
current_by_section.47: Meets Musashi on the mountain road; the two explicitly confess their love before he continues toward Ichijōji.
current_by_section.52: Receives Musashi's letter and is reunited with him and Jōtarō at Seta Bridge.
current_by_section.53: After Musashi's forceful embrace she rejects him and runs away, then returns toward the waterfalls and waits with Jōtarō.
current_by_section.97: Leaves Koyagyū, is carried off by a runaway ox and is rescued near Hannya Plain.
current_by_section.104: Is lured to Mikazuki and abducted, then Jōtarō intervenes and takes her to safety.
current_by_section.105: Goes back alone to the cave, frees Osugi and loses consciousness during the attack; Osugi repents and calls for help.
current_by_section.107: Recovers with Osugi's care and decides to continue toward Kokura with her and Jōtarō.
current_by_section.111: Meets Musashi again by the Heike Pine; the two explicitly acknowledge each other as wife and husband before he leaves.

current_by_section.23: Meets Tōji at Kizugawa harbor and takes him to the Sumiyoshi inn where the Yoshioka group is staying; the next morning she returns to Kyoto with him, leaving Akemi at Sumiyoshi with Seijūrō.
current_by_section.91: Attacks Gonnosuke at the Oinu and is killed with her own dagger.
current_by_section.31: It emerges that she has run off with Tōji and the money he had collected for the Yoshioka school.
current_by_section.60: Lives with Tōji, now a bandit chief, in Buna Valley between the Wada and Daimon passes; with him she sets a trap for Musashi, which fails, and is left tied to a tree as the cabin burns.

aoki_tanzaemon.role: Character tied to the Himeji garrison

current_by_section.4: Leads the search for Takezō and takes part in Ogin's arrest.
current_by_section.8: Is identified as Aoki Tanzaemon; Takuan reports that he has been dismissed from Ikeda's service and now wanders with no known destination.
current_by_section.12: Jōtarō reveals that Aoki Tanzaemon is his father and tells how they were separated.
current_by_section.20: Wanders as a mendicant near Fushimi and laments being separated from his son Jōtarō.
current_by_section.21: Fights Matahachi over food and nearly lets the Aoki name slip.
current_by_section.30: Saves Akemi from Yasoma's attack and shelters her in a ruined temple.
current_by_section.91: Travels toward Shōjuan and narrowly misses being reunited with Jōtarō.

kojiro.role: Young swordsman whose identity is revealed gradually

current_by_section.22: An unidentified young swordsman appears on the ship from Awa, describes his martial lineage and confronts Gion Tōji.
current_by_section.23: The young man disembarks separately at Kizugawa harbor.
current_by_section.25: After the clash with the Yoshioka disciples, Seijūrō explicitly identifies him as Sasaki Kojirō, known as Ganryū.
current_by_section.30: Kojirō rescues Akemi, treats her wound and carries her away from the ruined temple.
current_by_section.32: Meets Musashi for the first time; the two size each other up before Kojirō leaves again with Akemi.
current_by_section.33: Reaches the field with Akemi and, at Seijūrō's request, amputates the right arm that can no longer be saved.
current_by_section.35: Exposes Matahachi's imposture, identifies himself again as Kojirō/Ganryū and leaves him with a public notice.
current_by_section.37: Crosses paths with Osugi and Otsū while looking for Akemi.
current_by_section.44: Prevents a street fight and brokers the agreement for the public duel at Ichijōji.
current_by_section.46: Watches the Yoshioka preparations and suggests a move whose content is withheld.
current_by_section.47: Warns Musashi of the Yoshioka's superior numbers; Musashi insists on going alone.
current_by_section.49: Watches the fight at the Ichijōji pine from a raised position.
current_by_section.51: After disparaging Musashi to others, he finds he has been overheard and acknowledges a future rivalry with him.
current_by_section.52: Keeps Matahachi at a brothel, gets him drunk and stops him from reaching the Seta meeting.
current_by_section.81: Out of pride turns down Tadatoshi's first invitation and faces Yogorō at Isarago; the chapter does not reveal the outcome.
current_by_section.82: Yogorō's corpse is found; in the interview with Tadatoshi he gravely injures but does not kill Gorōji, and then visits him.
current_by_section.83: Kills two men attacking Matahachi and discovers that Akemi lives with him.
current_by_section.87: Confronts Ono Tadaaki, cuts his topknot and obtains Osugi's release.
current_by_section.94: Now in Hosokawa service, he sends Musashi a deadly challenge through Iori.
current_by_section.101: Leaves Sakai for Kokura with the Hosokawa party after meeting Iori.
current_by_section.108: In Kokura, before Tadatoshi, he throws down his wooden sword and declares himself no match for Ujiie; he learns the council has chosen Funashima for the duel and agrees that his marriage to Omitsu will wait until after the bout.
current_by_section.109: Writes his final instructions, receives supporters and his aunt, and keeps Tatsunosuke as his young attendant.
current_by_section.111: Leaves Kokura for Funashima after giving up his good-luck charms; Omitsu stays ashore.
current_by_section.112: Faces Musashi at Funashima and dies from the blow; the narrator explicitly rules out a return to life.

current_by_section.21: Flatters Matahachi when he claims to be Sasaki Kojirō, and swindles him.
current_by_section.30: Attacks Akemi, but Tanzaemon knocks him out.

iwa.role: Young blacksmith's apprentice in Baiken's household

current_by_section.26: Opens the door of the smithy at dawn where Musashi spent the night; it was Baiken's wife who received him the evening before.
current_by_section.28: Is in the house on the night Kōhei prepares the ambush on Musashi.

current_by_section.26: Receives Musashi at the smithy together with Iwa and the baby.
current_by_section.28: Is in the house when Musashi returns; her identity is not specified further.

arakida_ujitomi.role: Head of the House of Virgins at Ise

current_by_section.27: Dismisses Otsū after the gossip and entrusts her with painted scrolls to deliver to Karasumaru Mitsuhiro.

tsuge_sannojo.role: Traveler who helps Otsū and Jōtarō

current_by_section.29: Tricks Baiken's men with a false alarm, lets Jōtarō free Otsū and guides them toward Kyoto.

current_by_section.31: Receives Musashi with his wife but gives him a hostile welcome because of Osugi's accusations.
current_by_section.47: Musashi learns from a coffin maker that Kaname has died.

current_by_section.37: Finds Otsū unconscious but alive and confronts Osugi, who flees with Matahachi.
current_by_section.40: Meets Musashi again at the Ōgiya and joins the gathering in Yoshino's rustic cottage.
current_by_section.42: Entrusts Otsū and Jōtarō to Karasumaru and leaves at once for Tajima after learning that his mother is gravely ill.
current_by_section.85: With Ujikatsu and Munenori he backs the proposed appointment and the marriage plan, which Musashi does not accept.
current_by_section.91: Finds Iori and Jōtarō unconscious, hears the confession and sends Jōtarō to find his father.
current_by_section.93: Reveals Daizō's true identity, obtains lenient sentences and helps bring about Musashi's release.
current_by_section.96: Understands the reference to Iori's sister and Otsū's flute, without telling the boy her name outright.

koetsu.role: Craftsman and calligrapher whom Musashi meets

current_by_section.34: Meets Musashi with his mother Myōshū during a tea picnic and invites him to the house on Hon'ami Lane.
current_by_section.38: Hosts Musashi for a few days and takes him to the Ōgiya with Haiya Shōyū.
current_by_section.40: Joins the company in Yoshino's rustic cottage.
current_by_section.41: Urges Musashi to spend the night at Yoshino's and leaves the house with the other guests.
current_by_section.99: Meets Gonnosuke and Iori during the visit to Kongōji with Myōshū.
current_by_section.106: Sees Musashi off at Sakai, meets Gonnosuke who arrives too late, and walks back with him and Matahachi as far as Osaka.

myoshu.role: Kōetsu's mother, met at the picnic

current_by_section.34: Meets Musashi at the tea picnic and invites him to the house on Hon'ami Lane.
current_by_section.38: Hosts Musashi during the days he spends with the Hon'ami family.

haiya_shoyu.role: Merchant and connoisseur of Kyoto's cultural world

current_by_section.38: Accompanies Kōetsu and Musashi to the Ōgiya.
current_by_section.40: Spars playfully with Karasumaru and Konoe for Yoshino's attention.
current_by_section.41: Takes part in the hearth gathering and Yoshino's music.

yoshino_tayu.role: Tayū and musician of the Ōgiya

current_by_section.40: Welcomes the company into her rustic cottage and wipes Denshichirō's blood from Musashi's sleeve.
current_by_section.41: Plays the biwa, challenges Musashi's rigidity by showing him the instrument's structure and finds herself drawn to him, while he stays stiff and silent.
current_by_section.43: She would like Musashi to stay a few more days; kept busy by her guests, she has Rin'ya bring him an aloeswood-scented note when he leaves.
current_by_section.106: The narrator distinguishes her from the second Yoshino Dayū and states that her present fate is unknown.

yoshino_second.role: Former tayū of the Ōgiya and wife of Haiya Shōeki

current_by_section.106: Accompanies Shōeki when he sees Musashi off at Sakai. Musashi does not recognize her face; she is not the Yoshino he met in Kyoto.

karasumaru_mitsuhiro.role: Court noble and recipient of the scrolls entrusted to Otsū

current_by_section.40: Vies with Shōyū for Yoshino in a drinking contest and then, with Takuan, Shōyū and Kōetsu, accepts her invitation to her rustic cottage.

nampo_yoichibei.role: Senior figure close to the Yoshioka school

current_by_section.49: Is present at the mass fight; he is not recorded as dead without explicit proof.

current_by_section.93: Receives Musashi after his release from prison.

current_by_section.96: Agrees to look after Iori when Musashi sets off again.

current_by_section.100: Is brought bound to Kamuro as a suspected Edo spy; Daisuke silences the accusation in front of Sado.
current_by_section.106: Reaches Sakai too late for Musashi's ship and continues overland with Kōetsu.
current_by_section.111: Meets Musashi again by the Heike Pine and witnesses the farewells before the crossing.

current_by_section.57: Demands a rematch for her son before parting from Musashi.

geki.role: Samurai who offers Musashi service with the Date

current_by_section.59: Leaves for Wada Pass after secretly leaving money and a letter for Musashi.
current_by_section.67: It is reported that Musashi returned the money on a later journey to Sendai.

shoji_jinnai.role: Head of the traveling troupe Akemi journeys with

current_by_section.61: Travels with Jinnai's troupe near Kobotoke.
current_by_section.65: Is connected with the Sumiya setting where Kojirō looks for Akemi.

daizo.role: Herb merchant sought during Jōtarō's journey

current_by_section.61: Visits Yakuōin and reaches Hachiōji with Daizō and Jōtarō.
Strikes Jōtarō and sexually assaults Akemi; the event is established by the aftermath the chapter shows.

current_by_section.65: Looks for Hanagiri with Kojirō and Jūrō.

current_by_section.64: Accompanies Yajibei and Osugi to Sensōji and meets Kojirō.
current_by_section.76: Takes part in the ambush at Kōsuke's house and is killed by Shinzō.

current_by_section.95: Brings the official summons for Musashi to the cabin.

current_by_section.67: Dies in the Hōtengahara shack; Musashi helps Sannosuke bury him.

iwama_kakubei.role: Hosokawa retainer and supporter of Kojirō

current_by_section.70: Takes part in the search for Musashi at Hōtengahara.

current_by_section.72: Welcomes Musashi into her husband's house.
current_by_section.77: Helps while the wounded Shinzō is cared for.
